title: September payrolls: just +29K jobs, unemployment 4.2%
summary: Payrolls rose 29,000 against forecasts of roughly 84–89K, with July and August revised down by 60,000. The dollar dipped at first, then strengthened: EUR/USD finished 0.65% lower.
ict: Classic protraction: the first move went against the day’s eventual direction. An 8:30 a.m. NFP spike can leave a vacuum block that tends to fill the same session. Study it on a 15-minute chart.
